description: Functional scope: add secret-free classification/preflight for legacy AI provider credentials before Connect cutover; classify API-key, legacy resource-bound OAuth, explicitly configured no-auth, corrupt/unreadable, and ambiguous rows. Files: focused System migration context plus migration tests. Tests first: deterministic classification, corrupt ciphertext vs absent secret, duplicate/ambiguous OAuth grants, rerun safety, reports contain IDs/status only. Branches: all auth kinds and failure states. Mocking: real Repo/encryption; no HTTP. Docs: System config rollout. Action reuse: local-only operator migration operation; reuse System reads, Connect status APIs and existing OAuth/grant queries; not an agent tool/workflow action because it handles privileged secret migration. Contract: bounded/restartable secret-free report, fixed errors, no writes.
title: [zaq-jrg.23] AI credential compatibility preflight
